name: 気温と空気の状態を読む地図上の小さな案内
prompt:
Create one compact Japanese map weather card as a standalone mobile UI component, centered on a clean pure-white canvas with generous whitespace.

Reference priority:
1) The first image is a lossless crop of the actual product screenshot and controls the card’s silhouette, rounded corners, white surface, subtle floating shadow, two-row arrangement, partly-cloudy weather illustration, and exact temperature “22°”.
2) The second image shows the same source card in its map context; use it only to understand the gentle floating elevation.
3) The third image is a later Japanese adaptation mock. Use it only for the exact Japanese label “空気の状態 37” and Lighthouse green. Do not copy its changed proportions, flat green weather symbol, missing cloud-and-sun illustration, or icon placement.

Keep the source’s hierarchy: first row has a small warm orange sun partly behind a soft white/light-gray cloud on the left, with “22°” to its right. The second row has one small solid Lighthouse forest-green status dot on the left, followed by the exact text “空気の状態 37”. Keep both rows aligned to the same left inset and comfortably spaced. Preserve the card’s compact, softly rounded white shape and only a restrained cool-gray shadow.

Use Meiryo-style Japanese sans-serif. Set “22°” in regular weight at about 20 px, with the status line in regular 12 px type and enough line height to remain clear. Use near-black #1D1D1D for text, white #FFFFFF for the card, #2D8F5E for the status dot, and a warm golden-orange sun with a light neutral cloud. Retain clear contrast and fully formed Japanese glyphs. The translated status label may need a slightly wider card than the source while keeping the same concise two-row feel.

Show only this single card. Include no map, terrain labels, extra text, English labels, weather controls, additional icons, borders, other cards, or watermark. Keep the original weather illustration and status marker distinct.
reviewNotes: Agent-reviewed raster candidate. The source crop and map-context crop were inspected; the orange sun and pale cloud, 22°, two-row hierarchy, white floating card, and subtle shadow are retained. The exact Japanese copy 空気の状態 37 and Lighthouse semantic green come from the supplied adaptation. The card is a little wider to fit the Japanese line, and the generated white canvas differs from the native preview framing. No owner approval, editable-source, implementation, or runtime acceptance is implied.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
